new_policy: NO KNOWN CONFLICTING OPERATION MAY EXIST IN THE DOCUMENTED, ACCOUNT-VISIBLE EVIDENCE AVAILABLE TO AEGIS.
reason_for_change: Mission 048A established that the provider does not document a collector-scoped read-only current-operation listing for an unknown existing run, making a proof-of-absence requirement impossible to satisfy without undocumented behavior.
documented_provider_limitation: Known-snapshot retrieval and Self-Healing progress do not provide a collector-wide read-only listing of unknown active batch or real-time operations.

current_collector_evidence_interpretatio.semantics: UNKNOWN is neither known clear nor known conflict. It may permit the bounded policy only because documented available evidence contains no known conflict.
